headline: Colombia Central Bank Maintains Interest Rate at 12.25%
summary: The Board of Directors of the Bank of the Republic of Colombia decided by majority to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at 12.25%.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions are the primary tool for managing inflation and influencing economic growth in Colombia.
why_moved: The decision to hold rates steady impacts the cost of credit and currency valuation, influencing capital flows in the Colombian market.
